notes: Beta: shuffle is now a proper mix. Instead of drawing a fresh random order every time, songs are weighted by how long it's been since they last went out, how often they've played compared to the rest of your library, and how many listeners have tapped the heart on them — and it won't put two songs by the same artist back to back. Every song still plays once per pass; the weighting only decides where. Once a library is evenly played it settles back to an ordinary shuffle. Also in this build: linked Spotify and Apple Music playlists were quietly re-syncing every hour instead of every six — that's fixed, and songs the downloader can't find are now remembered and reported instead of being searched for over and over (with a "Retry missing songs" option). Song titles with accents in them reach listeners intact, adding music no longer files the same song twice under two different names, and the server keeps a much smaller log.
